fact_text: Sitara Petroleum says its group has been in the petroleum business for about 50 years, starting with fuel management and tank-lorry transport before adding retail sites.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Sitara runs about 61 gas stations and describes itself as probably the largest fuel-management company in Pakistan, a claim made by management.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Sitara's logistics fleet is the key logistics partner for an Aramco-linked fuel retail network, and most of that partner's product is moved by Sitara's tank lorries, per management.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Sitara's retail head was described as a former IBA graduate who worked at the largest oil marketing company and two other firms before joining Sitara.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Sitara's prospectus targets 47 petrol pumps, and the company says the build-out is planned for June 2027.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Sitara's retail development team has scanned about 100 potential sites, and 12 of them are in the approval process, according to management.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Sitara's IPO subscription for the public opens on 11 May 2026 on the PSX.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Sitara's IPO is expected to raise about Rs 4.8 billion, and 58% of the proceeds are to be invested in storage capacity.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Sitara says the storage build-out pays back in about four years, because storage can be rented to oil marketing companies that lack capacity.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Large storage operators rent capacity to oil marketing companies, and one OMC sometimes hosts others at its locations, so a storage gap in a region is an opening for new storage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Sitara's fuel stations hold between 3 and 8 days of inventory, enough to avoid running dry while limiting losses from price swings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Management said the government plans to raise the distribution (dealer) margin, which it expects to lift profit for fuel-station operators.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Price volatility and carrying cost are the main industry challenges; management suggests regular, such as weekly or fortnightly, price adjustments to protect dealer and OMC margins.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: A fuel-station operator carries less price-fluctuation risk than an OMC, which holds more inventory and bears more of the swings, according to the interviewee.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Sitara supplies fuel to corporate B2B customers such as Daewoo, and it relies on unused bank credit lines to fund extra carrying cost when product prices rise sharply.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Management said profit rose from about Rs 3.2 billion to above Rs 5 billion, and that the company beat its planned profit.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Management said the IPO is priced at a discount, and that its performance is ahead of plan, so the discount should let investors earn a return.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Sitara plans to commit about Rs 1.5 billion over its 5-year business plan to diversify, including EV and charging-related projects.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Management sees EVs as a hedge against the traditional fuel business, with a significant shift in fuel demand not expected until around 2040.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Sitara hired a specialist for non-fuel revenue and is upgrading convenience stores at its sites to draw customers beyond fuelling.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Management says it competes on easy access, fuel quality and quantity, customer service and convenience-store offer, with its sites branded for an Aramco-linked network.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Management expects digitalization to help both the fuel industry and government policy-making, and sees a higher dealer margin as a route to more profit for fuel-station operators.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Management said the company has committed a total of PKR 1.5 billion under its five-year business plan, with PKR 600 million also mentioned in that context.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Management described its convenience-store format as a way to differentiate from competitors, citing a station with 400 feet of frontage.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)

fact_text: Management said revenue has exceeded plan, reaching about PKR 150 billion (first stated as 120 billion), while profit rose from PKR 3.2 billion to over PKR 5 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Sitara Petroleum IPO: Strike Price, Retail Expansion & OMC Transition | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-04-29)
